== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Watchmen are members of the [[Blackwatch]], a disciplined and regimented order characterized by their distinctive long black coats, often adorned with silver buttons. Founded by a woman who chose the title to maintain equality with her male peers, the organization is viewed with a mixture of reverence and fear. While some see them as essential guardians protecting humanity from incomprehensible, unspeakable threats, others suspect they are a shady group or even an [[Elder cults|Elder cult]] that performs rituals to facilitate the end of the world. They are known to possess [[Authority|authority]] over [[Elders]] and have been involved in dangerous tasks, such as mining the flesh-like soil of [[Nakothi's island]] to harvest a Heart in pursuit of eternal life. Members of the order are often described as reclusive or suspicious, and some believe they develop a heightened intuition through years of service. The [[Blackwatch]] is led by figures such as [[Bliss of the Blackwatch|Bliss]] and her aide, [[Alsa Grayweather]], with the [[Blackwatch Guild Head|Head of the Blackwatch]] being a young woman. Beyond their role as protectors, there are theories that the Watchmen serve to produce disposable [[Emperors]] for the [[Elders]]. Their history and duties are documented in the [[Blackwatch]] Bestiary of [[Elders]], and they have been known to operate alongside other groups like [[Imperial Guards]], [[Magisters]], and Navigators.}}
